For BigCommerce Payments the Help Center article says automatic and manual payouts go "from your BigCommerce Payments balance" to a linked bank account or PayPal account (S01-BC-073, S01-BC-074), that the balance is on "a brand new PayPal platform account" (S01-BC-068, S01-BC-069), and that missing or reversed payouts go to PayPal support (S01-BC-085); it does not name who issues the payout. For Braintree it says only that funds "should appear in your bank account 2-5 days after the transaction has settled" (S01-BC-107). For Stripe OCS (S01-BC-098) and PayPal (S01-BC-090) the articles state it.
